decision: Permit the stable updater's official default GitHub API endpoint to use the same repository's canonical HTTPS latest-release redirect only after HTTP 403 or 429.
reason: The user's 123 to 124 update was blocked by a freshly reproduced GitHub API rate limit, while the official latest-release website resolved successfully to v1.0.124. Preserve public stable release authority without credentials or changes to the input runtime.
verification: Run actual update.sh in isolated homes with controlled HTTP responses before and after the repair. Cover exact-tag apply, no downgrade, real menu entrypoints, invalid/untrusted redirects, custom API isolation and unavailable fallback. Independently verify the installed updater's bytes and read-only live discovery.
not_tested: No new native field, rendering, latency, correction quality or input-route acceptance follows from updater checks. Permanent primary binary installation remains the user's menu operation.
